method: EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2 GPU time per render (median), vsync off, seed 42, paused, HUD hidden, identical cameras. Baseline = World Immersion 3.0 (67b0538) profile build; new = 3.1 profile build. One preview server at a time; baseline run then new run back to back.

W12b-mobile-street.note: The known +13.3% phone-street regression of 3.0 against ef407c7 is not worsened; 3.1 is 1.1% faster than 3.0.

round1FullRuns.note: Full capture runs: the baseline run was in a slower GPU state (overview 8.36 ms vs 6.86 ms in round 2), so round 1 is not used for comparison. Service, golden-hour and night views were timed only in round 1.
